data: Which of these model types had the lowest perplexity at the end of training?

The caption states that the figure shows test perplexity per epoch. The lines represent three different model types: random, flat, and learned. The y-axis represents perplexity, and the x-axis represents epochs. At the end of training (epoch 5), the learned model has the lowest perplexity among the three models. Therefore, the answer is the learned model.
